fact: UNFPA Bénin invited quotations, due 26 September 2025, to develop and deploy within 60 days a complementary module "Gestion de l'ESS" on EducMaster, which it describes as already deployed and used by the MEMP and the MESTFP, with interfaces for teachers, school heads, school nurses and departmental and national administrators; the work is under the control of UNFPA, the MEMP, the MESTFP and INIFRCF.
title: Demande de cotation pour la conception, le développement et le déploiement d'un module complémentaire "Gestion de l'ESS" sur la plateforme EducMaster du MEMP et du MESTFP au Bénin.
